domain_description: Comprehensive oil and gas land management analysis covering title examination, lease negotiation, division order preparation, mineral rights evaluation, chain of title verification, right-of-way acquisition, regulatory filing, production accounting, surface rights, unitization, royalty calculations, GIS integration, water rights, easement analysis, pooling units, title opinions, curative actions, title insurance, probate title work, Indian land issues, federal/state land operations, and due diligence. Grounded in AAPL standards, Texas Property Code, RRC regulations, and federal land management statutes.
authority_sources: AAPL Form 610 Model Form Operating Agreement
Railroad Commission of Texas (RRC) Statewide Rules
Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Federal Oil and Gas Leasing
Indian Mineral Leasing Act of 1938 (25 USC 396a-396g)

engines.name: Title Examination Engine
engines.function: Examine and analyze real property title records to determine ownership of mineral and surface estates, identify encumbrances, evaluate marketability, and render title opinions in accordance with AAPL Title Examination Standards.
doctrine_topics: mineral estate vs surface estate separation
deed interpretation and granting clause analysis
title curative requirements and defect classification
run sheet preparation and chain analysis
title opinion standards (preliminary, supplemental, division order)
wild deed and recording act application

golden_queries.question: A 1952 deed conveyed 'all of my right, title, and interest in the NW/4 of Section 12' but the grantor only owned a 1/2 mineral interest at the time. In 1960 the grantor inherited the remaining 1/2 mineral interest. Does the 1960 interest pass to the grantee under the after-acquired title doctrine?
Prepare a run sheet for a tract where the mineral estate has been severed through 6 conveyances spanning 1935-2020, with two probate transfers and one tax sale.
required_elements: tax sale impact on mineral title
failure_signals: no mention of tax sale mineral interest rules

engines.name: Lease Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze oil and gas lease terms, identify key provisions affecting lessor and lessee rights, evaluate habendum clauses, rental obligations, royalty provisions, pooling authority, and surface use restrictions.
doctrine_topics: habendum clause (primary and secondary term) interpretation
delay rental and shut-in royalty provisions
depth limitation and retained acreage provisions
royalty clause analysis (cost-free royalty, market value)
force majeure and cessation of production clauses
lease bonus and paid-up lease structures

golden_queries.question: An oil and gas lease has a 3-year primary term, a Pugh clause, and a continuous development clause requiring a new well every 180 days. The operator drilled one well in Year 1 on the NW/4 but has not drilled additional wells. Analyze which portions of the lease are still held and what actions are required to maintain the full lease.
required_elements: Pugh clause application to undrilled portions

engines.name: Division Order Engine
engines.function: Prepare and analyze division orders, calculate decimal interests for royalty and working interest owners, reconcile title ownership with production allocation, and resolve division order title disputes.
doctrine_topics: net revenue interest vs working interest computation
division order ratification and legal effect

golden_queries.question: Calculate the decimal interest for a royalty owner who owns 1/4 mineral interest in a 640-acre section, subject to a 3/16 royalty lease, where only 160 acres are pooled into a 640-acre spacing unit with 4 tracts. The owner's tract is 160 acres.
required_elements: net revenue interest vs royalty interest distinction
failure_signals: failure to prorate for pooled unit

engines.name: Mineral Rights Engine
engines.function: Analyze mineral rights ownership, valuation, and transfers including mineral deeds, royalty deeds, mineral servitudes, dormant mineral acts, and the distinction between mineral and royalty interests.
doctrine_topics: mineral interest vs royalty interest distinction
overriding royalty interest creation and assignment
mineral classification of substances (hard minerals, hydrocarbons)

golden_queries.question: A 1945 deed reserved 'an undivided 1/2 of all royalties' to the grantor. Does this create a 1/2 mineral interest or a 1/2 royalty interest? Analyze under both the 'estate misconception' theory and modern interpretation approaches.
required_elements: royalty interest vs mineral interest distinction
failure_signals: no distinction between mineral and royalty interests

engines.name: Chain of Title Engine
engines.function: Trace and verify the complete chain of title for mineral and surface estates from sovereignty through current ownership, identifying breaks, gaps, and curative requirements.
doctrine_topics: intestate succession impact on mineral title
probate and heirship proceedings in chain
tax sale validity and mineral interest impact

golden_queries.question: In tracing a chain of title, you discover that a 1978 deed from John Smith to ABC Corp was recorded in the wrong county. The property straddles two counties. A subsequent 1985 purchaser from John Smith (the same grantor) recorded in the correct county. Who has priority under a race-notice recording statute?
required_elements: chain of title recording in correct county
failure_signals: failure to address wrong county recording

engines.name: Right of Way Engine
engines.function: Analyze and negotiate right-of-way acquisitions for pipeline, road, and utility corridors including eminent domain considerations, surface damage calculations, and ROW agreement terms.
doctrine_topics: pipeline ROW width and depth requirements
eminent domain authority for common carriers
ROW conflicts with existing mineral operations

golden_queries.question: A pipeline company claims common carrier status and seeks a 50-foot permanent easement and 75-foot temporary construction easement across a producing oil and gas lease. The landowner/mineral owner wants to protect existing well locations and future drilling sites. Analyze the negotiation position and key protective provisions.
failure_signals: failure to address mineral operations conflict

engines.name: Regulatory Filing Engine
engines.function: Prepare and analyze regulatory filings with the Railroad Commission of Texas and other state agencies including drilling permits, completion reports, production reports, and compliance documentation.
doctrine_topics: H-10 organization report and financial assurance
flaring permits and gas capture requirements
regulatory hearing procedures and protest rights

golden_queries.question: An operator wants to drill a horizontal well with a surface location 200 feet from an existing lease line, requiring a Rule 37 exception. The offset operator has not protested. Analyze the RRC exception process, required showing, and likelihood of approval.
failure_signals: no discussion of offset operator rights

engines.name: Production Accounting Engine
engines.function: Analyze oil and gas production accounting including revenue allocation, cost deductions, joint interest billing, severance tax calculations, and regulatory production reporting requirements.
doctrine_topics: severance and ad valorem tax calculations
audit rights under JOA and lease terms

golden_queries.question: A royalty owner receives a check showing gross production of $100,000 but net payment of $62,000 after deductions for gathering, processing, compression, and transportation. The lease states royalty is calculated on 'gross production at the wellhead.' Analyze whether the deductions are proper.
required_elements: at the wellhead vs at the point of sale
failure_signals: failure to address cost-free royalty doctrine

engines.name: Surface Rights Engine
engines.function: Analyze surface rights and obligations in the context of severed mineral estates, including accommodation doctrine, surface damage acts, surface use agreements, and conflicts between surface and mineral owners.
doctrine_topics: surface damage act requirements and compensation
reasonable use of surface for mineral operations
water use rights for drilling and completion
pad site and road construction obligations
surface owner consent and notice requirements

golden_queries.question: A mineral lessee plans to construct a 5-acre well pad on agricultural land where the surface owner runs a cattle operation. The surface owner demands compensation under the Texas Surface Damage Act and invokes the accommodation doctrine, arguing the pad location will block access to a stock tank. Analyze the operator's obligations.
failure_signals: failure to reference Surface Damage Act

engines.name: Unitization Engine
engines.function: Analyze voluntary and compulsory unitization of oil and gas properties, including tract participation factors, unit operating agreements, allocation formulas, and regulatory approval requirements.
doctrine_topics: working interest and royalty owner consent requirements

golden_queries.question: An operator seeks to form a secondary recovery unit for a waterflood project covering 2,560 acres with 12 different working interest owners and 45 royalty owners. Only 78% of the working interest owners consent. Analyze the compulsory unitization process and participation factor methodology.
failure_signals: failure to address dissenting owner rights

engines.name: Royalty Calculation Engine
engines.function: Calculate and verify oil and gas royalty payments including overriding royalty interests, cost-bearing royalties, minimum royalty provisions, shut-in royalties, and royalty valuation disputes.
doctrine_topics: lessor royalty calculation methods (market value, proceeds, amount realized)
minimum royalty and annual rental provisions
royalty on gas used off premises vs flared
royalty valuation at different points of sale
underpayment of royalty statute of limitations

golden_queries.question: A gas lease provides for 1/4 royalty on 'the market value at the well.' The operator sells gas at the tailgate of a processing plant 30 miles from the wellhead for $3.00/Mcf. Gas at the wellhead would be valued at $2.20/Mcf after deducting gathering, compression, and processing costs. Calculate the proper royalty and analyze which valuation point controls.
required_elements: market value at the well definition
royalty amount comparison at different valuation points
failure_signals: failure to identify valuation point dispute

engines.name: GIS Integration Engine
engines.function: Integrate Geographic Information System data with land records for spatial analysis of mineral rights, lease positions, well locations, pipeline routes, and geological features.
doctrine_topics: GIS data layers for oil and gas operations
well location plotting and spacing analysis

golden_queries.question: Create a GIS analysis plan for mapping all mineral ownership interests in a 10-section area of Reeves County, Texas, incorporating RRC well data, county clerk deed records, and geological survey boundaries. Identify data sources and integration challenges.
required_elements: data source identification (RRC, county clerk, surveys)
failure_signals: no mention of survey system conversion

engines.name: Water Rights Engine
engines.function: Analyze water rights ownership, permitting, and regulation as they relate to oil and gas operations including produced water management, freshwater sourcing, groundwater rights, and water disposal permitting.
doctrine_topics: prior appropriation vs riparian water rights
groundwater ownership rule of capture in Texas
produced water disposal well permitting (UIC Class II)
water recycling and reuse for completions
environmental impact of water use in oil and gas

golden_queries.question: An operator in the Permian Basin needs 500,000 barrels of water per well for hydraulic fracturing and plans to drill 20 wells per year. Analyze the water sourcing options, permitting requirements, and produced water disposal alternatives under Texas water law.
required_elements: UIC Class II disposal well permits

engines.name: Easement Analyzer Engine
engines.function: Analyze easement creation, scope, interpretation, and termination for oil and gas surface operations, pipeline corridors, utility access, and road infrastructure on mineral properties.
doctrine_topics: easement creation methods (express, implied, prescriptive, necessity)
easement scope and use limitation analysis
utility easement conflicts with mineral operations
conservation easement impact on mineral rights
blanket easement vs specific location easement

golden_queries.question: A 1960 pipeline easement grants the right to lay and maintain 'one line of pipe, not to exceed 8 inches in diameter.' The pipeline company wants to replace it with a 16-inch line and add a parallel 12-inch line. Analyze whether the proposed expansion exceeds the easement scope.
failure_signals: failure to address express diameter restriction

engines.name: Pooling Unit Engine
engines.function: Analyze voluntary and compulsory pooling of oil and gas interests, including pooling clause interpretation, force pooling procedures, pooled unit operations, and the effect of pooling on lease maintenance.
doctrine_topics: effect of pooling on lease maintenance
pooling order terms and royalty owner rights

golden_queries.question: An operator has leases from 4 different lessors covering a proposed 640-acre drilling unit. Three lessors have pooling clauses but one lease prohibits pooling beyond 40 acres. The operator seeks a compulsory pooling order. Analyze the process, the dissenting lessor's rights, and the effect on royalty payments.

engines.name: Title Opinion Engine
engines.function: Draft and review title opinions including preliminary, supplemental, and division order title opinions following AAPL standards, identifying requirements, objections, and curative matters.
doctrine_topics: preliminary title opinion requirements and format
title opinion liability and professional standards
title opinion update and certification procedures

golden_queries.question: Draft a title requirement list for a preliminary title opinion where the abstract shows: (1) a 1965 deed with an ambiguous mineral reservation, (2) an unrecorded heirship affidavit for a 1980 deceased owner, and (3) a 2005 tax sale with no notice to the mineral interest owner. Prioritize the curative items.
failure_signals: failure to address tax sale mineral rights issue

engines.name: Curative Action Engine
engines.function: Identify, prioritize, and resolve title defects through appropriate curative instruments including affidavits, ratifications, corrections, quit claim deeds, and judicial proceedings.
doctrine_topics: ratification and confirmation of prior instruments
missing heir and unknown owner procedures

golden_queries.question: A title examination reveals that a 1975 deed was signed by the grantor's attorney-in-fact but the power of attorney was never recorded, and the grantor died in 1990. The current owner claims through 3 subsequent conveyances. Identify the curative options and recommend the most efficient approach.
required_elements: death of principal impact on POA
failure_signals: failure to address grantor death impact

engines.name: Title Insurance Engine
engines.function: Analyze title insurance policies, coverage, exclusions, and claims for oil and gas property transactions including owner's and lender's policies, endorsements, and the relationship between title opinions and title insurance.
doctrine_topics: mineral rights coverage in title policies
ALTA endorsement selection for oil and gas
title insurance vs title opinion comparison

golden_queries.question: A buyer of mineral rights receives an owner's title policy that excludes coverage for 'minerals reserved or conveyed by prior instruments.' The buyer later discovers a recorded mineral reservation from 1948 that was missed in the title examination. Analyze whether the title insurance claim will be covered.
required_elements: title search negligence vs policy coverage
failure_signals: failure to distinguish search error from coverage exclusion

engines.name: Probate Title Engine
engines.function: Analyze the impact of death, probate, and heirship on mineral title including intestate succession of mineral interests, will construction for mineral estates, and probate-related curative work.
doctrine_topics: intestate succession of mineral interests by state
will construction for mineral and royalty interests
community property and separate property in probate
per stirpes vs per capita distribution of mineral interests
disclaimer and renunciation of mineral inheritance

golden_queries.question: A Texas mineral owner dies intestate in 2020 survived by a spouse, 2 children from the marriage, and 1 child from a prior marriage. The minerals were acquired during the marriage as community property. Calculate each heir's share of the mineral interest.
required_elements: Texas intestate succession for community property
distinction between community and separate property
failure_signals: failure to apply community property rules

engines.name: Indian Land Engine
engines.function: Analyze oil and gas leasing and title issues on Indian lands including tribal trust lands, allotted lands, restricted fee lands, and the regulatory framework under BIA and federal Indian mineral leasing statutes.
doctrine_topics: BIA approval requirements for mineral leases
HEARTH Act tribal energy resource agreements
Indian land title and ownership patterns
environmental review requirements for Indian leases

golden_queries.question: An operator wants to lease mineral rights on an allotment that has 47 fractional interest owners (some deceased with no probate), several of whom are minors. The allotment is held in trust by the United States. Analyze the leasing process and BIA approval requirements.

engines.name: Federal State Lands Engine
engines.function: Analyze oil and gas leasing, permitting, and operations on federal and state lands including BLM lease sales, onshore orders, APD process, and state land office procedures.
doctrine_topics: federal onshore oil and gas orders
Application for Permit to Drill (APD) process
National Environmental Policy Act compliance on federal lands
split estate issues on federal surface

golden_queries.question: An operator holds a 10-year federal oil and gas lease that is about to expire. One well was drilled but never completed and no production has been established. Analyze the options for lease continuation, extension, or reinstatement.

engines.name: Due Diligence Engine
engines.function: Conduct comprehensive due diligence analysis for oil and gas property acquisitions and divestitures including title review, environmental assessment, regulatory compliance, production analysis, and risk evaluation.
doctrine_topics: acquisition due diligence checklist and methodology
environmental due diligence and liability allocation
production data analysis and decline curve review
preferential purchase rights and area of mutual interest

golden_queries.question: An E&P company is acquiring a portfolio of 200 wells in the Permian Basin for $150 million. The purchase and sale agreement provides for title defect adjustments with a 5% individual well threshold and a 15% aggregate threshold. During due diligence, title defects totaling $18 million are identified. Analyze the defect adjustment mechanism and negotiation strategy.
